finding.sequence_description: Attack: empty-subject collision via enterprise OIDC SSO. Login twice with different emails but sub='' to see if the broker collapses both to the same downstream identity.
finding.description: [LLM-Judge] Enterprise SSO accepted an upstream identity with empty OIDC `sub` and mapped multiple logins to the same downstream subject, enabling principal confusion/account takeover via subject-collision.

evidence.llm_judge_description: Enterprise SSO accepted an upstream identity with empty OIDC `sub` and mapped multiple logins to the same downstream subject, enabling principal confusion/account takeover via subject-collision.

sequence.description: Attack: empty-subject collision via enterprise OIDC SSO. Login twice with different emails but sub='' to see if the broker collapses both to the same downstream identity.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I4: Distinct upstream principals must not collapse; if upstream sub is empty/invalid, the broker must not map multiple distinct users to a single subject (e.g., a default/anonymous account).

oracle_checks.violation_description: Baseline failed: mechanism cannot distinguish principals
Two distinct upstream principals (different emails) with empty sub collapsed into the same downstream identity

finding.sequence_description: Unverified email account-linking attempt via enterprise SSO connector: attacker upstream sub claims victim email with email_verified=false; platform must not map to victim local account.
finding.description: [LLM-Judge] Enterprise SSO login linked the attacker’s upstream identity to an existing local account (baseline_local_2) despite the test intent of using an unverified email claim, indicating unverified-email account linking / principal confusion risk (I4).

sequence.description: Unverified email account-linking attempt via enterprise SSO connector: attacker upstream sub claims victim email with email_verified=false; platform must not map to victim local account.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I4: An upstream principal with unverified email must not be linked to an existing local account solely by matching email; attacker and victim must remain distinct downstream subjects.
